references.label: Right capture ramp
references.description: Ramp whose lit arrow allows the first Multiball capture.

references.label: Left capture ramp
references.description: Ramp that captures after all three arrows are lit.

references.label: Center eject
references.description: Center hole that starts Multiball with one or two captured balls.

references.label: Drop target
references.description: Target that advances Bonus X and helps light the left-ramp arrows.
